preconditions.description: There are exactly two input strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in args)

postconditions.description: The number of newline characters in the output is equal to the length of the longer input string minus one.
Each line in the output contains exactly one space.

postconditions.expression: all(char in args[0] or char == ' ' for char in return_value.split('\n')[0].split())
postconditions.description: The first character of each line in the output is either from the first input string or a space.

postconditions.expression: all(char in args[1] or char == ' ' for char in return_value.split('\n')[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second character of each line in the output is either from the second input string or a space.
